shortDescription: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said on Thursday he believes it is necessary to discuss term limits for Supreme Court justices.

children: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva said on Thursday he believes it is necessary to discuss term limits for Supreme Court justices.
The remarks come amid a clash between top court justices that has triggered the court's biggest crisis in decades.
Lula, who is seeking reelection in October, told SBT TV the crisis is an institutional one within the Supreme Court, and has nothing to do with the government.
